S.FORM: izua aya tua ku milimilingan, izua aya zua maraɫak a ti Kuɫeɫeɫeɫe kati Pulelelelengan a setjarivavaw, aya.
S.PHON: izua aja tua ku miɭimiɭiŋan izua aja zua maraʎak a ti kuʎəʎəʎəʎə kati puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan a səcarivavaw aja
S.FORM: izua aya tua ku milimilingan, izua aya zua maraljak a ti Kuljeljeljelje kati Pulelelelengan a setjarivavaw, aya.
S.PHON: izua aja tua ku miɭimiɭiŋan izua aja zua maraʎak a ti kuʎəʎəʎəʎə kati puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan a səcarivavaw aja
S.TRANSL: There were according to my story, there were a parent and child called Kuɫeɫeɫeɫe and Pulelelelengan who lived in the world above, they say.

S.FORM: izua maḍusaḍusa selapay nu nasepuɫu aravats, aya.
S.PHON: izua maɖusaɖusa səɭapaj nu nasəpuʎu aravaʦ aja
S.FORM: izua madrusadrusa selapay nu nasepulju aravac, aya.
S.PHON: izua maɖusaɖusa səɭapaj nu nasəpuʎu aravaʦ aja
S.TRANSL: With only the two of them they were extremely lonely, they say.

S.FORM: "qai, qunu, qai mai sapuɫu itjen.
S.PHON: qai qunu qai mai sapuʎu icən
S.FORM: "qai, qunu, qai mai sapulju itjen.
S.PHON: qai qunu qai mai sapuʎu icən
S.TRANSL: "Well, son, we are lonely.

S.FORM: qai muri tjemavang itjen tua vaung tua lizuk tua gadu," aya tiamadju a maraɫak, aya.
S.PHON: qai muri cəmavaŋ icən tua vauŋ tua ɭizuk tua gadu aja tiamaɉu a maraʎak aja
S.FORM: qai muri tjemavang itjen tua vaung tua lizuk tua gadu," aya tiamadju a maraljak, aya.
S.PHON: qai muri cəmavaŋ icən tua vauŋ tua ɭizuk tua gadu aja tiamaɉu a maraʎak aja

TRANSL.notes: [tjemavang: tjavang in F is ‘offer to spirits’]

S.TRANSL: Now we'll make the sea, the plains and the mountains," said the parent and child, they say.

S.FORM: manu izuanga nakipalinguɫ a vaung.
S.PHON: manu izuaŋa nakipaɭiŋuʎ a vauŋ
S.FORM: manu izuanga nakipalingulj a vaung.
S.PHON: manu izuaŋa nakipaɭiŋuʎ a vauŋ
S.TRANSL: So then there was the sea all around.

S.FORM: izuanga tiamadju itua tjaɫavavavan a gadu a tjemavatjavang tua vaung tua lizuk tua gadu, aya.
S.PHON: izuaŋa tiamaɉu itua caʎavavavan a gadu a cəmavacavaŋ tua vauŋ tua ɭizuk tua gadu aja
S.FORM: izuanga tiamadju itua tjaljavavavan a gadu a tjemavatjavang tua vaung tua lizuk tua gadu, aya.
S.PHON: izuaŋa tiamaɉu itua caʎavavavan a gadu a cəmavacavaŋ tua vauŋ tua ɭizuk tua gadu aja
S.TRANSL: There they were on the highest mountain making the sea, the plains and the mountains, they say.

S.FORM: "qai qai, muri puɫauɫaung itjen tua maretimaɫimaɫi a kasiw a venutsiatsiar a venangavangaɫ tua kakanen a mareka kaizuazua," aya uta, aya.
S.PHON: qai qai muri puʎauʎauŋ icən tua marətimaʎimaʎi a kasiw a vənuʦiaʦiar a vənaŋavaŋaʎ tua kakanən a marəka kaizuazua aja uta aja
S.FORM: "qai qai, muri puljauljaung itjen tua maretimaljimalji a kasiw a venuciaciar a venangavangalj tua kakanen a mareka kaizuazua," aya uta, aya.
S.PHON: qai qai muri puʎauʎauŋ icən tua marətimaʎimaʎi a kasiw a vənuʦiaʦiar a vənaŋavaŋaʎ tua kakanən a marəka kaizuazua aja uta aja

TRANSL.notes: [venutsiatsiar: F also has vetsiar] | [venangavangaɫ: was venagavangaɫ]

S.TRANSL: "Well we'll get shade from the various kinds of trees that have blossom and bear fruit for food of all kinds(?)," they said too, they say.

S.FORM: manu izuanga uta naseleman anga a gadu a kasiw matatukalulum anga matatuzarzarzar anga vutsiar, aya.
S.PHON: manu izuaŋa uta nasəɭəman aŋa a gadu a kasiw matatukaɭuɭum aŋa matatuzarzarzar aŋa vuʦiar aja
S.FORM: manu izuanga uta naseleman anga a gadu a kasiw matatukalulum anga matatuzarzarzar anga vuciar, aya.
S.PHON: manu izuaŋa uta nasəɭəman aŋa a gadu a kasiw matatukaɭuɭum aŋa matatuzarzarzar aŋa vuʦiar aja
S.TRANSL: And so the mountains became shaded (?); trees got ripe in turn and the blossoms became bright in turn, they say.

S.FORM: nuka tsemel anga tsinuvuqan anga sepeɫuq a kana qipuqipu anga, aya.
S.PHON: nuka ʦəməɭ aŋa ʦinuvuqan aŋa səpəʎuq a kana qipuqipu aŋa aja
S.FORM: nuka cemel anga cinuvuqan anga sepeljuq a kana qipuqipu anga, aya.
S.PHON: nuka ʦəməɭ aŋa ʦinuvuqan aŋa səpəʎuq a kana qipuqipu aŋa aja
S.TRANSL: Grass too sprang up, and all the ground was full up, they say.

S.FORM: manu "qai muri pukuku itjen, qunu, tua qemuzimuzip tua qayaqayam tua ɫemanguɫanguy i taladj tua vaung," manu aya uta tiamadju a maraɫak, aya.
S.PHON: manu qai muri pukuku icən qunu tua qəmuzimuzip tua qajaqajam tua ʎəmaŋuʎaŋuj i taɭaɉ tua vauŋ manu aja uta tiamaɉu a maraʎak aja
S.FORM: manu "qai muri pukuku itjen, qunu, tua qemuzimuzip tua qayaqayam tua ljemanguljanguy i taladj tua vaung," manu aya uta tiamadju a maraljak, aya.
S.PHON: manu qai muri pukuku icən qunu tua qəmuzimuzip tua qajaqajam tua ʎəmaŋuʎaŋuj i taɭaɉ tua vauŋ manu aja uta tiamaɉu a maraʎak aja
S.TRANSL: Then "Now we'll have pets, child; animals, birds and things that swim in the sea," the parent and child also said, they say.

S.FORM: saka tjikezem, manu ka tsimeraw izuanga uta; nekanga nuka ita ika izua.
S.PHON: saka cikəzəm manu ka ʦiməraw izuaŋa uta nəkaŋa nuka ita ika izua
S.FORM: saka tjikezem, manu ka cimeraw izuanga uta; nekanga nuka ita ika izua.
S.PHON: saka cikəzəm manu ka ʦiməraw izuaŋa uta nəkaŋa nuka ita ika izua

TRANSL.notes: [ita: not in original text, but required here]

S.TRANSL: So they closed their eyes, and when they opened them, there it all was; there was not a thing missing;

S.FORM: nekanga nu kinaqusaw tua kuku, aya.
S.PHON: nəkaŋa nu kinaqusaw tua kuku aja
S.FORM: nekanga nu kinaqusaw tua kuku, aya.
S.PHON: nəkaŋa nu kinaqusaw tua kuku aja
S.TRANSL: they weren't missing any pets, they say.

S.FORM: saka izuanga tiamadju a talidulidu sakamaya, aya.
S.PHON: saka izuaŋa tiamaɉu a taɭiduɭidu sakamaja aja
S.FORM: saka izuanga tiamadju a talidulidu sakamaya, aya.
S.PHON: saka izuaŋa tiamaɉu a taɭiduɭidu sakamaja aja
S.TRANSL: So there they were just enjoying themselves, they say.

S.FORM: "qai, qunu, djavadjavay ɫakua ku pai sa-u ḍi, ɫizavu a tja sikataqaɫan i tjariteku," ayain ti Pulelelelengan nua zua kama ti Kuɫeɫeɫeɫe, aya.
S.PHON: qai qunu ɉavaɉavaj ʎakua ku pai sau ɖi ʎizavu a ca sikataqaʎan i caritəku ajain ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan nua zua kama ti kuʎəʎəʎəʎə aja
S.FORM: "qai, qunu, djavadjavay ljakua ku pai sau dri, ljizavu a tja sikataqaljan i tjariteku," ayain ti Pulelelelengan nua zua kama ti Kuljeljeljelje, aya.
S.PHON: qai qunu ɉavaɉavaj ʎakua ku pai sau ɖi ʎizavu a ca sikataqaʎan i caritəku ajain ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan nua zua kama ti kuʎəʎəʎəʎə aja
S.TRANSL: "Now, child, I'm sorry but off you go and see our fellows in the world below," said father Kuɫeɫeɫeɫe to Pulelelelengan, they say.

S.FORM: "manu ika na ku ɫizaven ḍi, kama, ki kemudakuda?" aya ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: manu ika na ku ʎizavən ɖi kama ki kəmudakudaʔ aja ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.FORM: "manu ika na ku ljizaven dri, kama, ki kemudakuda?" aya ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: manu ika na ku ʎizavən ɖi kama ki kəmudakudaʔ aja ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.TRANSL: So "If I go to see them,(?) father, what am I to do?" said Pulelelelengan, they say.

S.FORM: qau "ui, djavadjavay, ɫakua sa-u kivakini ki pasemalaw a tja sikataqaɫan, qunu.
S.PHON: qau ui ɉavaɉavaj ʎakua sau kivakini ki pasəmaɭaw a ca sikataqaʎan qunu
S.FORM: qau "ui, djavadjavay, ljakua sau kivakini ki pasemalaw a tja sikataqaljan, qunu.
S.PHON: qau ui ɉavaɉavaj ʎakua sau kivakini ki pasəmaɭaw a ca sikataqaʎan qunu
S.TRANSL: "Yes, I'm sorry, but go; our fellows will tell you, child.

S.FORM: ɫakua maya patjekutjekuɫ tua tjelu a puluq a qadaw, ḍi, sa su pangtjez sa su kitsepeliw a sema maza," aya ti Kuɫeɫeɫeɫe tua zua aɫak a ti Pulelelelengan a pazazekazekatj, aya.
S.PHON: ʎakua maja pacəkucəkuʎ tua cəɭu a puɭuq a qadaw ɖi sa su paŋcəz sa su kiʦəpəɭiw a səma maza aja ti kuʎəʎəʎəʎə tua zua aʎak a ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan a pazazəkazəkac aja
S.FORM: ljakua maya patjekutjekulj tua tjelu a puluq a qadaw, dri, sa su pangtjez sa su kicepeliw a sema maza," aya ti Kuljeljeljelje tua zua aljak a ti Pulelelelengan a pazazekazekatj, aya.
S.PHON: ʎakua maja pacəkucəkuʎ tua cəɭu a puɭuq a qadaw ɖi sa su paŋcəz sa su kiʦəpəɭiw a səma maza aja ti kuʎəʎəʎəʎə tua zua aʎak a ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan a pazazəkazəkac aja
S.TRANSL: But don't stay longer than 30 days and come back here," ordered Kuɫeɫeɫeɫe to his child Pulelelelengan, they say.

S.FORM: sa vaik ti Pulelelelengan a ɫemizaw tua i tjariteku, aya.
S.PHON: sa vaik ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan a ʎəmizaw tua i caritəku aja
S.FORM: sa vaik ti Pulelelelengan a ljemizaw tua i tjariteku, aya.
S.PHON: sa vaik ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan a ʎəmizaw tua i caritəku aja
S.TRANSL: So Pulelelelengan went to visit the world below, they say.

S.FORM: manu zemuker i tjariteku maka tjaia Muatjukutjuku azua ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: manu zəmukər i caritəku maka caia muacukucuku azua ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.FORM: manu zemuker i tjariteku maka tjaia Muatjukutjuku azua ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: manu zəmukər i caritəku maka caia muacukucuku azua ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.TRANSL: And Pulelelelengan arrived in the world below by way of the Muatjukutjuku house, they say.

S.FORM: manu ka zemuker anga, "keɫu, ɫa sikataqaɫan.
S.PHON: manu ka zəmukər aŋa kəʎu ʎa sikataqaʎan
S.FORM: manu ka zemuker anga, "kelju, lja sikataqaljan.
S.PHON: manu ka zəmukər aŋa kəʎu ʎa sikataqaʎan
S.TRANSL: And when he had arrived, he kept saying: "Come here, fellow villagers,

S.FORM: qa keɫu satjaiqayavu tjanuaken.
S.PHON: qa kəʎu sacaiqajavu canuakən
S.FORM: qa kelju satjaiqayavu tjanuaken.
S.PHON: qa kəʎu sacaiqajavu canuakən
S.TRANSL: come to me.

S.FORM: ku nu tjautsikelay ku nu pasemalavay," ayaya timadju.
S.PHON: ku nu cauʦikəɭaj ku nu pasəmaɭavaj ajaja timaɉu
S.FORM: ku nu tjaucikelay ku nu pasemalavay," ayaya timadju.
S.PHON: ku nu cauʦikəɭaj ku nu pasəmaɭavaj ajaja timaɉu

TRANSL.notes: [ku nu: note double preposed pronouns, see Egli p.156-7.]

S.TRANSL: I will speak to you and explain to you."

S.FORM: sa qepuqepu-i(?) a setjariteku, sa pasekeɫangi tua nanguaqan nua kinaizuanan, tua izua kama nimadju a tjaɫakiɫivakan, nu ayaya, qai ka sekeɫang anga a i tjariteku, "qu manu kemuda a nu izua tjananguaq tua tja kinaizuanan, a nu izua rukiɫivakan aravats," aya zua setjariteku, aya.
S.PHON: sa qəpuqəpuiʔ a səcaritəku sa pasəkəʎaŋi tua naŋuaqan nua kinaizuanan tua izua kama nimaɉu a caʎakiʎivakan nu ajaja qai ka səkəʎaŋ aŋa a i caritəku qu manu kəmuda a nu izua canaŋuaq tua ca kinaizuanan a nu izua rukiʎivakan aravaʦ aja zua səcaritəku aja
S.FORM: sa qepuqepui a setjariteku, sa pasekeljangi tua nanguaqan nua kinaizuanan, tua izua kama nimadju a tjaljakiljivakan, nu ayaya, qai ka sekeljang anga a i tjariteku, "qu manu kemuda a nu izua tjananguaq tua tja kinaizuanan, a nu izua rukiljivakan aravac," aya zua setjariteku, aya.
S.PHON: sa qəpuqəpuiʔ a səcaritəku sa pasəkəʎaŋi tua naŋuaqan nua kinaizuanan tua izua kama nimaɉu a caʎakiʎivakan nu ajaja qai ka səkəʎaŋ aŋa a i caritəku qu manu kəmuda a nu izua canaŋuaq tua ca kinaizuanan a nu izua rukiʎivakan aravaʦ aja zua səcaritəku aja
S.TRANSL: So he gathered the people of the world below, and explained to them the goodness of his place, and about his most loving father. And when the people of the world below understood this, they said: "So that's how it is; so there is a place better than our place, and there is someone really loving," said the people of the world below, they say.

S.FORM: saka a(?) mapuzangal anga tua patsun tua sema tjarivavaw, aya.
S.PHON: saka aʔ mapuzaŋaɭ aŋa tua paʦun tua səma carivavaw aja
S.FORM: saka a mapuzangal anga tua pacun tua sema tjarivavaw, aya.
S.PHON: saka aʔ mapuzaŋaɭ aŋa tua paʦun tua səma carivavaw aja
S.TRANSL: And they longed to see and to get to the world above, they say.

S.FORM: "qai, ɫa sikataqaɫan, patjatjautsiketsikelu anga ḍi, pasekeɫangu anga a ika nakiqepu a ika ku sintsevungan(?) ḍi; uɫa mun a kemɫang a mapuɫat tua kiɫivak ni kama, tua nanguaqan nua i tjarivavaw," aya ti Kuɫe-Pulelelelengan.
S.PHON: qai ʎa sikataqaʎan pacacauʦikəʦikəɭu aŋa ɖi pasəkəʎaŋu aŋa a ika nakiqəpu a ika ku sinʦəvuŋanʔ ɖi uʎa mun a kəmʎaŋ a mapuʎat tua kiʎivak ni kama tua naŋuaqan nua i carivavaw aja ti kuʎəpuɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan
S.FORM: "qai, lja sikataqaljan, patjatjaucikecikelu anga dri, pasekeljangu anga a ika nakiqepu a ika ku sincevungan dri; ulja mun a kemljang a mapuljat tua kiljivak ni kama, tua nanguaqan nua i tjarivavaw," aya ti KuljePulelelelengan.
S.PHON: qai ʎa sikataqaʎan pacacauʦikəʦikəɭu aŋa ɖi pasəkəʎaŋu aŋa a ika nakiqəpu a ika ku sinʦəvuŋanʔ ɖi uʎa mun a kəmʎaŋ a mapuʎat tua kiʎivak ni kama tua naŋuaqan nua i carivavaw aja ti kuʎəpuɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan
S.TRANSL: "Fellow villagers, tell one another; explain to the people who didn't turn up, whom I haven't met; so that you will all know the love of my father and the goodness of the world above," said Kuɫe-Pulelelelengan.

S.FORM: sa vaik a kitsepeliw a sema tua kama i tjarivavaw, aya.
S.PHON: sa vaik a kiʦəpəɭiw a səma tua kama i carivavaw aja
S.FORM: sa vaik a kicepeliw a sema tua kama i tjarivavaw, aya.
S.PHON: sa vaik a kiʦəpəɭiw a səma tua kama i carivavaw aja
S.TRANSL: And he went back to his father in the world above, they say.

S.FORM: sa tjautsiketsikel anga tua kama a ɫemitaɫita tua kinaitjaritekuan ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: sa cauʦikəʦikəɭ aŋa tua kama a ʎəmitaʎita tua kinaicaritəkuan ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.FORM: sa tjaucikecikel anga tua kama a ljemitaljita tua kinaitjaritekuan ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: sa cauʦikəʦikəɭ aŋa tua kama a ʎəmitaʎita tua kinaicaritəkuan ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.TRANSL: And Pulelelelengan told his father everything that he had done in the world below, they say.

S.FORM: selapay nu namalevaleva aravats a "manu izua nanguaq matu sa tja kinaizuanan, manu zua izua mamazangiɫan aravats a rukiɫivak," aya setjariteku.
S.PHON: səɭapaj nu namaɭəvaɭəva aravaʦ a manu izua naŋuaq matu sa ca kinaizuanan manu zua izua mamazaŋiʎan aravaʦ a rukiʎivak aja səcaritəku
S.FORM: selapay nu namalevaleva aravac a "manu izua nanguaq matu sa tja kinaizuanan, manu zua izua mamazangiljan aravac a rukiljivak," aya setjariteku.
S.PHON: səɭapaj nu namaɭəvaɭəva aravaʦ a manu izua naŋuaq matu sa ca kinaizuanan manu zua izua mamazaŋiʎan aravaʦ a rukiʎivak aja səcaritəku
S.TRANSL: And the people were very glad. "So there is something good like our own place. And there is a real chief who is truly loving," said the people of the world below,

S.FORM: saka namalevanga aravats, saka sa su u iravaravanga sa su(?) kalevalevanga tua sema tjarivavaw a kitjaviliɫ tua ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: saka namaɭəvaŋa aravaʦ saka sa su u iravaravaŋa sa suʔ kaɭəvaɭəvaŋa tua səma carivavaw a kicaviɭiʎ tua ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.FORM: saka namalevanga aravac, saka sa su u iravaravanga sa su kalevalevanga tua sema tjarivavaw a kitjavililj tua ti Pulelelelengan, aya.
S.PHON: saka namaɭəvaŋa aravaʦ saka sa su u iravaravaŋa sa suʔ kaɭəvaɭəvaŋa tua səma carivavaw a kicaviɭiʎ tua ti puɭəɭəɭəɭəŋan aja
S.TRANSL: and they were very glad, "So get ready and be glad to go to the world above following Pulelelelengan," they said (?).
